title: Docsviewer
description: x-docsviewer wires a documentation browser: each .docs-link child loads its src into the #doc-viewer child (through that child's x-mdhtml when it is ready) and becomes the active (btn-primary) link. The host itself reads no attributes.

src.description: Set on each .docs-link child, not on the host: the Markdown file that link loads into #doc-viewer.

_metadata.derivedFrom: docs-viewer.js docsviewer() — every property here is one the behavior reads
